age.evidence: Xenografts were established in female athymic nude mice (Hsd:athymic Nude-Foxn1nu, ages 6–7 weeks; Envigo, Indianapolis, IN) as previously described.

anatomic_site_tumor.evidence: inferred: Mass spectrometry-based quantitative proteomics profiling of in vivo signaling changes in 16 GMB xenograft tumors treated with vehicle and erlotinib (5 mg/kg, 33 mg/kg, 100 mg/kg).

cell_line.evidence: The GBM12 PDX model has been previously described, full genotypic and phenotypic characterization is available from the Mayo Clinic PDX National Resource (http://www.mayo.edu/research/labs/translational-neuro-oncology/mayo-clinic-brain-tumor-patient-derived-xenograft-national-resource).

material_type.evidence: Tumor material (whole flank tumor) was collected from mice (n = 4 per treatment group: vehicle, 5 mg kg−1 erlotinib, 33 mg kg−1 erlotinib, and 100 mg kg−1 erlotinib) and snap frozen in liquid nitrogen.
